Structurally, the text treats the analytical combinations of the *sappaccayaduka* (the dyad of conditioned states and associated groupings) in conjunction with the fundamental *kusalattika* (the triad of wholesome, unwholesome, and undetermined phenomena), applying the relational conditions (*paccaya*) characteristic of the *Paṭṭhāna* methodology.
